configuration: GCC15.2 and Clang21.1.8 C++23 O2 checked/skip default/native, plus O1 ASan+UBSan default checked/skip. CPU8, ASAN detect_leaks=0.
raw_note: Reference and exception fixtures were extended and rerun in all12 configurations; latest result per(config,test) retained below. Source did not change between runs.

coverage.reference: 180 random strings,3036 prefixes, independently enumerated all substrings/palindromes and overlapping frequencies; naive LCS scans; all palindrome fields, creation IDs, roots, longest/suffix, copies/moves/swaps/resets, foreign bytes; all256 individual byte values, NUL-only/254–255 subalphabets and byte boundaries.
coverage.long_chain: One million repeated bytes per library plus200000 periodic bytes; iterative build, suffix links, clone cases, large occurrence caches, reset/clear.
coverage.exception: 28–29 allocator failure positions by compiler/mode, all normal_live0=0. Constructor/append/batch/alias append/copy/reset/reserve/cache failure; pre-reserved append allocates no memory. Capacity SIZE_MAX rejected even under SKIP.
coverage.input_checks: Invalid batch byte preserves processed prefix; invalid node checked in default; query foreign byte is mathematical mismatch in all modes.

drivers.origin: Pinned official Library Checker inputs; expected output from Python all-substring sets, all-candidate LCS and prefix/suffix palindrome enumeration, independent of both automata.
